fed_rate_cut_q2.question: Will the Fed cut rates in Q2 2026 (before July 1)?

sources.goal: List all Fed governor speeches from the last 14 days. For each return: speaker name, date, title, and whether the tone is hawkish (against cuts) or dovish (for cuts) or neutral. Return as JSON array with keys: speaker, date, title, tone.
Extract the current GDPNow GDP estimate for Q1 2026 and the date it was last updated. Return JSON with keys: estimate, previous_estimate, last_updated.

Extract the most recent Beige Book release. Return JSON with keys: release_date, overall_tone (one of: expanding, slowing, contracting), key_phrases (array of the 3 most important quoted phrases about inflation or employment).
Find the current probability of a Fed rate cut at the next FOMC meeting according to FedWatch. Return JSON with keys: next_meeting_date, cut_probability, hold_probability, hike_probability.
Extract the most recent employment situation summary. Return JSON with keys: release_date, jobs_added, unemployment_rate, wage_growth_yoy, summary_sentence.

btc_100k.question: Will Bitcoin exceed $100,000 by end of Q2 2026?

sources.goal: Find recent 8-K filings mentioning Bitcoin from large companies. Return JSON array with keys: company, date, summary of what they said about Bitcoin.
Extract the top 5 most recent Bitcoin market news headlines and their publication times. Return JSON array with keys: headline, time, sentiment (bull/bear/neutral), summary.
Extract the Bitcoin ETF flow data for the last 5 trading days. Return JSON with keys: total_net_flow_5d, largest_single_day_inflow, largest_single_day_outflow, trend (increasing/decreasing/flat).

eth_etf.question: Will an Ethereum spot ETF be approved before July 2026?

sources.goal: Find recent SEC filings related to Ethereum ETF applications. Return JSON array with keys: applicant, filing_date, filing_type, status, key_detail.
Find any upcoming SEC hearings or deadlines related to cryptocurrency ETF applications. Return JSON array with keys: date, description, relevance_to_eth_etf.
